blocks.html: Fields used to apply flexible filters on strings.

types.name: lt
types.description: The filtered string must be less than this value.

types.name: gt
types.description: The filtered string must be greater than this value.

types.name: gte
types.description: The filtered string must be greater than or equal to this value.

types.name: lte
types.description: The filtered string must be less than or equal to this value.

types.name: contains
types.description: The filtered string must contain this value.

types.name: starts_with
types.description: The filtered string must start with this value.

types.name: ends_with
types.description: The filtered string must end with this value.
